secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com → API keys). Powers the /api/chat/openai proxy. Optional — app falls back to demo mode without it.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com → API keys). Powers the /api/chat/anthropic proxy. Optional.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio API key (aistudio.google.com → Get API key). Powers the /api/chat/google proxy. Optional.

secrets.name: XAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: xAI/Grok API key (console.x.ai → API keys). Powers the /api/chat/grok proxy. Optional.
